name: BUAN Compute Bundles Profiles
summary: Computes BUAN bundle profiles of white matter pathways with the DIPY 1.1.1 dipy_buan_profiles workflow, comparing subject bundles against model bundles and saving the profiles in HDF5 files.
description: Wraps dipy_buan_profiles (Bundle Analytics, Chandio et al. 2020) with --no_disks, a model bundle folder and a subject folder read from config.json, writing results to output/. Note that the registry record defines no inputs, outputs or parameters, while main expects model_bundle_folder, subject_folder and no_disks in config.json, so the App cannot be run as registered (see report).

citations.text: Chandio BQ, et al. Bundle analytics, a computational framework for investigating the shapes and profiles of brain pathways across populations. Scientific Reports 10, 17149 (2020).
